login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Welcome back to Routy.
login.setupSubtitle: No profile exists yet — create the first account.

profile.title: Create a new profile
profile.subtitle: Every profile has its own stats, but shares access to the same path network.
profile.success: Profile created. You can now sign in.

route.title: Suggest a route
route.noRouteFound: No route found within the configured length range.
route.activeNotice: You have an active route. Confirm it as walked, or discard it to get a new suggestion.
route.discardConfirm: Really discard this route? It won't count as walked.
route.completedMessage: Nice, well done! The route now counts toward your stats.
route.explorerModeHint: Prefers path segments that have never been walked.
route.favoriteStale: This route includes segments that have since been deleted and can no longer be taken.

import.title: Submit a path
import.subtitle: Upload a GPX file. Any tracks it contains are detected, and you confirm which known node each start and end point belongs to.
import.nameConflictWarning: Heads up: a node named "{name}" already exists, but it's {distance} m away. Use it anyway?
import.noTracks: No usable tracks were found in this file.

map.title: Network
map.subtitle: All known nodes and path segments.
map.deleteConfirm: Really delete this path segment? This cannot be undone.
map.interactionHint: Click a path to edit it. Click a node for more options.
map.moveNodeActive: Drag active — drag the node on the map
map.deleteNodeConfirm: Really delete this node and the {count} path segment(s) connected to it? This cannot be undone.
map.deleteBlockedNode: This node can't be deleted — it's currently used by an active route.
map.deleteBlockedSegment: This path can't be deleted — it's currently used by an active route.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: These values control how generously nodes get merged and how routes are selected.
settings.merge_radius_m_hint: Points within this radius are treated as the same node.
settings.name_far_warn_m_hint: Warn when a same-named node is farther away than this.
settings.tolerance_percent_hint: How far a route may deviate from the target length.
settings.widen_step_percent_hint: How much the tolerance grows per "New route" click.
settings.daily_diversity_weight_hint: How strongly paths already walked today are penalized in new suggestions.
settings.walk_speed_kmh_hint: Default for profiles without their own value, and for GPX files with no timestamps.
settings.walkSpeedSubtitle: Overrides the network default for your profile only — affects the estimated duration of new paths and routes.
settings.walkSpeedHint: Leave empty to use the network default (currently {default} km/h).
settings.suggest_min_km_hint: Lower bound of the length range a route is suggested from.
settings.suggest_max_km_hint: Upper bound of the length range a route is suggested from.
settings.adjust_step_percent_hint: How much the route changes on a "Longer" or "Shorter" click.

stats.title: Stats
stats.subtitle: Your walks, and how the path network is used overall.
stats.noSegments: No path segments in the network yet.
stats.deleteWalkConfirm: Really delete this walk from your history? Your stats will be adjusted accordingly.

draw.title: Draw on the map
draw.instructions: Click the map to place points. Near a known node (dashed circle) a click snaps to it automatically.
draw.dragHint: Drag a placed point to position it more precisely.

edit.title: Edit path
edit.subtitle: Drag individual points to correct the path's shape, or click the path to split it at a new junction.
edit.splitBlockedActive: This path can't be split right now — it's currently used by an active route.

special.trailblazerDesc: Submitted a path segment of your own
